outlook.statement: Post implementation of RERA, developers are focusing on selling existing ready inventory and finishing near-completion projects rather than launching new projects; RERA shall result in consolidation in the sector with smaller developers interested in monetizing land parcels or entering into joint development/development management agreements; overall Real Estate sector is showing growth as compared to last year and will emerge stronger, healthier and capable of long periods of sustained growth provided adequate policy/regulatory support.
